purpose: Teach: 霊魂/病床/擬似/昇華/接合/減免/詰め込ん/付託

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、亡くなられた患者さんの霊魂を医療チームで慰める儀式を設けます
lines.en: Ren, we've established a ritual for the medical team to honor the memory of patients we've lost.
lines.style: Steady, composed delivery. Clear without being clinical. A pause before the second clause—acknowledging the weight of what's being said. Quiet respect threading through.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、病床にある患者さんへの寄り添いを医療チームで重視します
lines.en: Yes. Our medical team places real emphasis on being present with patients during their time in bed.
lines.style: Measured, reassuring tone. Not rushed. Each phrase lands with quiet conviction. The kind of calm that comes from having done this work for years.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 擬似的な医療効果を主張する商品に、貴院、警鐘を鳴らしてますね、先生
lines.en: That's something your hospital clearly takes a stand on—products that claim medical benefits without real backing.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly formal register. Respectful but genuinely curious. Leans into the observation with a soft uptick, not questioning authority but genuine intellectual interest.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さんの苦悩を治療プロセスに昇華する努力を医療チームで続けます
lines.en: Yes. We continue to work as a team to transform patient suffering into something meaningful within the treatment process.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate pacing. The language is elevated but not distant. A small breath before 'suffering' — acknowledging its weight. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 骨の接合手術を、貴院、ご担当ですね、先生
lines.en: That's one of your hospital's specialties, isn't it—bone fusion surgery, sensei?
lines.style: Curious, respectful. Genuine question, not testing. Slight rise at the end. The tone of someone learning from someone they respect.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療費の減免制度を医療チームでご案内します
lines.en: Yes. Our medical team guides patients through the financial assistance programs available to them.
lines.style: Professional, clear, and warm. Not transactional—this is care too. Even pacing. The focus is on the patient's access, not the paperwork.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 過剰に投薬を詰め込んだ処方を、貴院、避けられてますね、先生
lines.en: I've noticed your hospital avoids over-prescribing—that's not always an easy stance to take.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently admiring. Understands this requires restraint. Steady tone with subtle warmth. Acknowledgment of difficulty beneath the observation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、難しい判断は倫理委員会に付託します
lines.en: Yes. When the judgment calls become difficult, we defer to our ethics committee.
lines.style: Quiet authority. Final statement—not closing off conversation but settling into genuine principle. Slow, even pace. A small exhale before 'ethics committee' — the weight of that responsibility.
